spec_references: Expressions: Literal — Currently support `nil-literal`, `boolean-literal`, `numeric-literal` and `string-literal` only
reason: The test expects a panic when indexing the six-code-point string hello👋 at index 6. String literals and member access expressions are supported without a restriction excluding string indexing or its out-of-range panic behavior. test_design_notes: The @panic comment marks the expected runtime failure; the supplementary Unicode character makes the string six code points long.
